title: How to Enhance Downstream Adversarial Robustness (almost) without Touching the Pre-Trained Foundation Model?
abstract: arXiv:2504.10850v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With the rise of powerful foundation models, a pre-training-fine-tuning paradigm becomes increasingly popular these days: A foundation model is pre-trained using a huge amount of data from various sources, and then the downstream users only need to fine-tune and adapt it to specific downstream tasks. However, due to the high computation complexity of adversarial training, it is not feasible to fine-tune the foundation model to improve its robustness on the downstream task. translated_title: 如何在不（几乎）触碰预训练基础模型的情况下增强下游对抗鲁棒性？
translated_abstract: 随着强大基础模型的兴起，预训练-微调范式如今变得越来越流行：基础模型使用来自各种来源的海量数据进行预训练，然后下游用户只需对其进行微调以适应特定的下游任务。然而，由于对抗训练的高计算复杂度，通过微调基础模型来提升其在下游任务上的鲁棒性是不可行的。针对上述挑战，我们希望在不更新或访问基础模型权重的情况下提高下游鲁棒性。受现有鲁棒性继承文献的启发（Kim et al., 2020），通过理论研究，我们发现鲁棒对比学习与监督学习的对抗鲁棒性之间存在密切关系。为了进一步验证并利用这一理论见解，我们设计了一种简单而有效的方法
tldr: 该论文通过理论揭示鲁棒对比学习与监督学习对抗鲁棒性之间的密切关系，提出了一种无需更新或访问预训练基础模型权重即可有效增强下游任务对抗鲁棒性的简单方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a close theoretical relationship between robust contrastive learning and supervised adversarial robustness, and proposes a simple-yet-effective method to enhance downstream adversarial robustness without updating or accessing the weights of the pre-trained foundation model.
